None of the accepted children resolves capacity or improves the benchmark interval, so credit is limited to scoped structural results, exact audits, finite-grid foundations, and route-pruning. The residual preserves uncertainty from substitution among converse routes, public-source rediscovery, and overlap in general search reduction.
